create_dynamic_quantized_linear: create a dynamic quantized linear module with floating point inputs and outputs using specified in and out features
build_quantized_linear_forward: build a forward pass for a dynamic quantized linear layer that runs quantized matrix multiplication on input tensors
create_from_float_module: create a dynamic quantized linear module from a float torch.nn.Linear module with a defined qconfig
create_from_reference_module: create a dynamic quantized linear module from a reference quantized module preserving weight and bias
test_dynamic_quantized_linear: test the dynamic quantized linear module forward pass with floating point tensor inputs and verify output shape
